I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team. The next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse, who posted it in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing posted there since changes it. Marcus is a member of that channel, so he could already see it. I told him I couldn't find an account file or contract to check the date against, so Ilse is the one to confirm it with if the account sheet needs a source.
